# WebNameAttribute

Kind: Class  
Namespace: `Sisk.JsonRPC.Annotations`  
Assembly: `Sisk.JsonRPC.dll`  
Source: https://docs.sisk-framework.org/api/Sisk.JsonRPC.Annotations.WebNameAttribute.html

Represents an attribute which holds the class name for a group of
JSON-RPC methods.

```csharp
[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Class)]
public sealed class WebNameAttribute : Attribute
```
